data.cultural_impact: The name Margery or Margaret was popular in medieval Europe, where it was one of the most common names for women. It was often given to girls born to noble or royal families, and was also popular among peasants and the middle class.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Margery or Margaret is often associated with the Virgin Mary, who is referred to as the "Pearl of Great Price" in the Bible (Matthew 13:45-46). This name was also given to those who were particularly devoted to Mary or wanted to honor her.
